questions.question: Summarize the discussion about the effect of training on different languages
questions.reference_answer: Using multiple languages led to more diversity which potentially hindered the model performance. The professor was skeptical about discussing the results since they had not received any good ones so far.

questions.question: What did PhD D explain about the multilingual model?
questions.reference_answer: PhD D explained that the multilingual model, trained on French, Spanish, and English, was trained with higher frame rates. It has slightly poorer results when delta was not used. All in all, the addition of English did not seem to help the model.

questions.question: What did the Professor think about the use of English?
questions.reference_answer: The professor thought that the model did not get hurt that much because of the removal of English. He also thought it would be worthwhile to train on one language and test on another.

questions.question: Summarize the discussion on managing the complexity of the model
questions.reference_answer: The team discussed the size of the neural net, which was just a simple net. At the time, it had 27 outputs, but the professor recommended that they use a larger net, with perhaps more features. They discussed the effect that removing silent frames could have on the model. The professor recommended having a bigger hidden layer, though he did not think that would substantially improve performance. Currently, however, the team was facing computational limitations.

questions.question: What did the team discuss about IBM computers?
questions.reference_answer: The team was concerned about the availability of computational resources. The Professor informed them that they had received two 550 megahertz processors by IBM. Though, they were originally expecting eight 800 megahertz processors.

questions.question: What did the team think about delays?
questions.reference_answer: The team talked about delays when discussing the removal of frames that were silent. This could possibly improve model performance at the cost of a small delay.
